# Intrinity Fire Protection LLC

> Texas fire protection contractor based in Austin. Installs, inspects, and repairs fire sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, and backflow preventers for commercial and residential properties in Austin, San Antonio, Houston, and Dallas. 24/7 emergency service.

## Facts

- Legal name: Intrinity Fire Protection LLC
- Based in: Austin, Texas (service-area business, no public storefront)
- Service area: Austin, San Antonio, Houston, and Dallas, Texas
- Phone: (254) 613-4231, answered 24/7 for emergencies
- Email: orion@intrinityfire.com
- Owner: Orion Trinidad
- Experience: backed by 30 years of fire protection industry experience
- Insurance: fully insured
- Google reviews: 76 reviews, 5.0 average (as of October 2026)
- Customers: mostly commercial (general contractors, property managers, facility managers, restaurant owners, building owners), plus homeowners

## Services

- Fire sprinkler systems: installation, inspection (NFPA 25 schedules), and repair; wet pipe and dry pipe
- Fire alarm systems: installation, inspection, monitoring, and repair
- Backflow prevention: annual backflow testing with utility test reports, and backflow repair
- Fire pumps: inspection and repair
- Kitchen hood suppression: testing, inspection, and repair
- Fire extinguishers: inspection and replacement
